about: How CGS first reaches a company: the principles, the ways in (channels) and the limits the outreach agent plans with (api/outreach_plan.py). The agent proposes a contact plan for one lead: whom to approach first and why, who else matters, and two to five steps over a few weeks; a person approves it before anything is drafted. Written by the project team from general B2B practice and CGS's public website. It holds nothing from CGS's internal guides: replace or extend it with CGS's own playbook once CGS agrees to share it with the AI.
principles: A warm path beats any cold channel: if a colleague already works with this company or knows this person, start there.
Without a relationship, give something useful before asking for time: a relevant CGS piece, an invitation, or one sharp question about the reader's own situation.
A cold email is one option, not the default. Use it first only when it is clearly the best way in, and say why.
The best way in is the person who owns the problem behind the news and can open a conversation, not automatically the most senior name. Say who signs the budget only when the sources show it.
Approach one person at a time. Add a second person only with a reason the sources support, and never send two people the same message.
Sharing alone is not a plan: by the last step at the latest, ask for one easy, specific conversation.
Every step gives the reader a new reason to talk; never repeat the step before.
Stop the plan when the person replies, accepts a meeting or says no. A person decides what happens next.

email.label: Email
email.use: A short personal email with one point about the reader's situation and one easy ask.

linkedin_connect.label: LinkedIn connection request
linkedin_connect.use: A connection note (at most 200 characters) with one concrete reason to connect. The person sends it on LinkedIn.

linkedin_message.label: LinkedIn message
linkedin_message.use: A message after the person accepted the connection. Only after a linkedin_connect step to the same person.

share_content.label: Share a CGS piece
share_content.use: Send one CGS report, whitepaper, article or case that fits the reader's situation, with two lines on why it is relevant. No ask beyond 'worth a look'.

invite.label: Invitation
invite.use: Invite the person to a CGS workshop, talk, roundtable or webinar that fits their situation.

warm_intro.label: Introduction through someone who knows them
warm_intro.use: Ask a CGS colleague or an existing contact who knows the person to introduce CGS. Only when the brief or other CGS work shows such a path.

call.label: Phone call
call.use: A short call, usually after an earlier step got a response or when a colleague made the introduction.
